title: Player/GM UX, Accessibility, Notifications & Recognition History

implementation_scope.purpose: Define deterministic read-only Player/GM UX projection contracts for ALP learning and recognition state, including accessibility presentation metadata, notification candidates and recognition history, over the frozen ALP-01 through ALP-06 contracts without taking mutation authority from owning systems.
authorized: explicit viewer role and viewer identity for player-facing versus GM-facing ALP projections
read-only projection of authorized learning, achievement, practice, rehearsal and recognition references from frozen ALP-01 through ALP-06 contracts
accessibility presentation metadata and caller-supplied display preferences that alter presentation only, not canonical ALP or owner-system state
deterministic notification-candidate projection for authorized ALP events or state changes without delivery, acknowledgement or external messaging side effects
deterministic recognition-history projection with stable record identity, source family, provenance and timestamp/order metadata when explicitly supplied
role-aware visibility in which missing, hidden or unauthorized evidence and recognition records remain unknown or omitted without hidden cardinality inference
deterministic ordering and receipts independent of supplied view-record, notification-candidate and recognition-history ordering
not_authorized: achievement awarding, completion mutation or recognition creation by implication
notification sending, delivery, external messaging, acknowledgement-state mutation or subscription mutation
automatic XP, advancement, capability, title, reputation or reward grants
hidden or unauthorized evidence, event, history or cardinality inference
direct Character Progression, Reputation/Relationship/Faction, World/Scene, Project, GCL, ISE or MAL mutation
universal permission or unrelated capability gates
ALP-08 MAL/ISE/WCI/GCL integration or golden learning/recognition proof behavior
provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment
